content.title: Witnessed Capability | Gear, Performance, Crowd, Challenge
content.summary: Pose a capability question through readable equipment detail, reveal the performer, and complete one continuous demonstration. Let the crowd's surprise, filming, and clearing of space become public proof, then introduce a second participant to hand off the next challenge.

quick_start.input_format: equipment-contact close-up + stable performer + continuous capability action + same-space witness reaction + second-participant challenge handoff
quick_start.recommended_input: A courier locks a graphite spring-heel brace onto a cobalt shoe sole and performs one final latch check. The courier completes two short rebounds, one cross-body turn, and one backward glide before landing with both feet in the original lane. A second courier enters from the opposite direction on an amber flat-board glide device and stops at a distant marker; the first courier turns to face them while the crowd leaves a clear corridor.
required_anchors: Present the enabling equipment in readable physical contact before revealing the full performer.
Reveal one stable performer and enough public context to establish who will demonstrate and who can witness it.
Include a spatially connected bystander response after the feat rather than a detached reaction insert.
Introduce a second participant or counter-action only after the solo proof is complete.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Pose a capability question through readable equipment detail, reveal the performer, and complete one continuous demonstration. Let the crowd's surprise, filming, and clearing of space become public proof, then introduce a second participant to hand off the next challenge.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Open on a legible piece of unusual equipment so the viewer asks what it enables, then reveal and lock one performer identity. Prove the capability through a continuous action phrase whose contact, direction changes and completion remain visible. Widen only after the feat so bystander reactions, recording behavior or cleared space act as social proof. End by introducing a second participant or counter-move that transfers the completed demonstration into a fresh challenge. The mechanism is capability-to-witness-to-challenge progression, not a specific skating style or plaza.

invariants.purpose: Turns claimed capability into inspectable proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Montage-only fragments can conceal whether the action was completed.

invariants.rule: Include a spatially connected bystander response after the feat rather than a detached reaction insert.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated reaction faces do not verify the demonstrated event.

invariants.purpose: Creates forward momentum without interrupting the evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early competition muddies whose capability was established.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source young red-haired woman, black jacket, white shirt and exact facial identity
the source black multi-wheel inline shoes, fastening details and exact cross-step choreography
the source modern waterfront plaza, sunset crowd circle and spectators holding phones
the source exact close-shoe to face reveal to crowd-reaction progression
the source final second female skater entrance, wardrobe, staging and photographic surface
